title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
blurb: Tiny changes, remarkable results — systems over goals.
description: Clear’s core idea is simple: you do not rise to the level of your goals; you fall to the level of your systems. The book shows how to make good habits obvious, attractive, easy, and satisfying — and how to reverse those levers for habits you want to break. Practical, short chapters, built for people who are tired of motivation spikes that fade by Wednesday.
